title: GroundedSelfReport
description: Human-facing self-report that is DOWNSTREAM of internal state, not invented from prose style. Every report must carry references back to the state/broadcast/trace that grounds it ('show receipts'). Forbidden claims (sentience/phenomenal-consciousness/moral-patienthood without met thresholds) are filtered before emission. Output contract v0.1.

report_text.description: Functional, honest phrasing preferred (e.g. 'high verification-seeking state'), with human-readable gloss subordinate. Never an official interiority claim.

affect_state_hash.description: PsycheStateFrame.state_hash this report is grounded in. REQUIRED — a report with no state hash is ungrounded and invalid.

workspace_broadcast_id.description: The broadcast that prompted this report.

causal_trace_id.description: The CausalTrace backing the report's claims.

evidence_refs.description: Concrete internal quantities the report cites (manifold values, InstinctSignal ids, scar refs, ledger entries).

uncertainty.description: The report's own stated uncertainty about its introspective content.

filtered_forbidden_claims.description: Claims that were detected and REMOVED before emission (audit trail for the manipulation/consciousness-claim guard). Empty is the healthy case.
